verdict.rationale: Cua Bench's `@evaluate_task` inspects each run's final state and returns rewards, scoring oracle, human or agent runs the same way. That gives a per-run success signal you can compare across runs, and trajectory export adds per-run records. Nothing in the evidence shows duration or token/dollar cost being reported, so only one of the three metrics in the story is covered. Missing for 10: per-run duration reporting, token or dollar cost reporting, documented run-comparison view or report, independent corroboration.
